result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but the 'Popular right now' listing has a clear text-overlap rendering bug, plus several truncation/consistency problems in the carousels and cards.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' the metadata line renders two overlapping strings ('25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' printed on top of each other), making the delivery time and fee illegible.
issues.suggestion: Render the metadata as a single flex row with separators ('25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') and avoid absolutely positioned/duplicated text nodes.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza) is cut off by the bottom tab bar with no visible name, rating or padding, so the card looks broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding equal to the tab bar height to the scroll container so cards are never clipped mid-content.

issues.description: The favourite (heart) icon on the pizza card uses a dark, nearly opaque circle on a dark image, giving very low contrast, while the same icon on the ramen card is white — inconsistent and hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent icon treatment (e.g., white icon on a semi-transparent dark scrim) and verify contrast against varied imagery.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel clips the third card's title ('Trattoria Piccol…') at the screen edge with no peek affordance, and the category chip row is also cut mid-chip.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal gutters/partial-card peek and truncate titles with an ellipsis inside the card bounds so clipping looks intentional.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while sibling thumbnails are dark, making the row look visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Normalise image backgrounds or apply a uniform overlay/gradient so the badge text and cards read consistently.
